_comment: VALIDATED subset of tasks-archive.json (XERK-445 Phase 0). Every task here has
passed bench/validate_tasks.py: with the fix reverted the repo's own tests FAIL,
and with it restored they PASS. No model judges anything.
Every task has also passed curate.py's answer-leak gate: the prompt names no file
the task reverts, no test that grades it, and echoes fewer than two identifiers
the fix introduces. Three earlier cuts of this set failed that check -- see
docs/routing-eval-phase0.md -- which is why the gate is as blunt as it is.
tasks fail that pass on their own, which once cost two good tasks.
A failing task must be re-run ALONE before it is believed: server.test.js has a
~10% flaky test (XERK-450) and 9 of these tasks grade on it.
47 tasks: 25 Turma + 22 Tenir (XERK-449). The Tenir tasks carry an opt-in
dependency bootstrap (setup_cmd) and a test_cwd, because Tenir is an npm-
workspaces monorepo: JS suites grade with 'npx vitest' from inside a workspace
and its api suite with pytest from api/. 22 of the 29 Tenir candidates survived
re-validation; the 7 drops span multiple workspaces or projects in one command,
which no single test_cwd can grade. See bench/METHOD.md's bootstrap section.
